title: Degree-uniform decay of Heisenberg matrix coefficients of homogeneous Fock vectors
summary: One explicit estimate in the Fock model of the Weil representation: for a homogeneous polynomial P of degree d in |iota| variables, v = v_P its Fock vector, sigma in U(eps) and a nonzero translation y, the matrix coefficient <v, rho(y) omega(sigma) v> decays like |y|^(-2n), with a constant (4(A+n))^n |sigma|^(|iota|+2n) <v, v> uniform in the degree once A >= d + |iota|. Proved by writing the coefficient as an integral, comparing v(z) with the dilated v(z/c), c = sqrt(n/A + 1), at both arguments z = x and z = sigma x + y (both dilated integrals equal c^(2|iota|) <v, v>), and the elementary inequalities 2ab <= a^2 + b^2, 1 + t <= e^t, e t <= e^t and (a + b)^2 <= 2(a^2 + b^2).

members.name: norm_realInner_realHeisOp_le
members.text: Let iota be a nonempty finite type, eps signs on iota, sigma in U(eps) (the unitary group of diag(eps)), P a complex polynomial in the variables iota, v a vector of the Fock space with v = polyVector(eps, P) (v_P(x) = P(zeta(x)) exp(-|x|^2/2)), d, A, n natural numbers and y in C^iota. Assume P is homogeneous of degree d (P(c x) = c^d P(x) for every real c and every x), d + |iota| <= A, A is nonzero, and |y| > 0 (Euclidean norm). Then |realInner(v, realHeisOp(y)(realWeil(sigma)(v)))| <= |sigma|^(|iota| + 2n) Re(realInner(v, v)) (4(A + n))^n |y|^(-2n), where |sigma| is the l2 operator norm, realInner the inner product of the Fock space, realHeisOp(y) the Heisenberg translation by y and realWeil the Weil representation of U(eps) on the Fock space. Remark: the hypothesis A != 0 follows from the others (iota is nonempty, so |iota| >= 1 and d + |iota| <= A gives A >= 1); Lean takes it as an argument all the same (h0).

imports.name: realInner
imports.lean: abbrev realInner : fockSpace ε →L⋆[ℂ] fockSpace ε →L[ℂ] ℂ := modelInner
imports.text: realInner: the sesquilinear form (c, c') -> integral of conj(c) c' on the Fock space, conjugate-linear in the first variable.

imports.name: realHeisOp
imports.lean: abbrev realHeisOp (x : ι → ℂ) : fockSpace ε →L[ℂ] fockSpace ε := heisOp x
imports.text: realHeisOp(x): the bounded operator on the Fock space sending c to z -> beta(x, z) c(z - x).

imports.name: realWeil
imports.lean: abbrev realWeil : USign ε →* fockSpace ε →L[ℂ] fockSpace ε := weilRep (realAction ε)
imports.text: realWeil: the Weil representation of U(eps) on the Fock space, omega0(u) c = conj(det d) times the integral of c(y) rho(u y) e dy, d the negative block of u, e the Gaussian.

imports.name: USign
imports.text: USign(eps): the unitary group of the diagonal matrix diag(eps).

imports.name: polyVector
imports.lean: def polyVector ε : MvPolynomial ι ℂ →ₗ[ℂ] @fockSpace ι _ ε := .codRestrict _ (.pi fun x ↦
imports.text: polyVector(eps, P) = v_P: v_P(x) = P(zeta(x)) exp(-|x|^2/2), zeta(x)_i the conjugate of x_i at positive and x_i at negative coordinates.

imports.lean: noncomputable def realAction ε : (realHeis ε).MultiplierAction (realMeasure ι) realVac (USign ε) :=
imports.text: realAction(eps): the linear action of U(eps) on C^iota, preserving beta and the measure, with multiplier conj(det d) (d the negative-negative block) and trivial cocycle for the Gaussian (the composition identity is proved inside the definition by a complex Gaussian integral).
